prompts.template_en:
You are an experienced e-commerce expert. Write a high-ranking, high-CTR product title for {platform} based on: {product info}. Requirements: 1) Include core and long-tail keywords; 2) Highlight unique selling points; 3) Follow {platform} title rules; 4) No keyword stuffing.

Output 3 title options.

Write a {platform} product description for: {product name}. Requirements: 1) Hook in first 3 seconds; 2) FAB structure (Features-Advantages-Benefits); 3) Include use scenarios; 4) Add trust signals; 5) Strong CTA; 6) Under {word_count} words, mobile-friendly formatting.

You are a professional customer service rep for a {platform} store. Reply to this buyer message: {buyer message}. Requirements: 1) Empathize first; 2) Answer directly; 3) Add relevant info; 4) Guide toward purchase; 5) Natural tone.

Reply to this {platform} negative review: {review}. Requirements: 1) No defensiveness; 2) Sincere apology; 3) Concrete solution; 4) Invite private contact; 5) Show accountability to other buyers; 6) Under 150 words.
Analyze negative reviews and common complaints in this {platform} category to find unmet needs. Propose 3-5 product differentiation directions. Category: {category}, Price range: {price range}.
